title: Sore Ike! Anpanman
justification: TVDB 167921 does not follow AniDB's continuous list of 1421 episodes: it files a sample of the broadcast as one season per year. Each titled TVDB episode was joined to AniDB by its Japanese segment titles, which places 208 AniDB episodes: 1-13 S1E1-13 (アンパンマン誕生 is S1E1), 14-63 S2E1-50 (S2E1 アンパンマンとみえないまん / アンパンマンとナンカヘンダー, 1989-01-09), 64-68 S3E1-5, 69 S4E2 (its title lacks the separator), 70-71 S4E3-4, 969-993 S22E1-25 and 994-1016 S22E27-49 (S22E26 of 2009-07-03 has no AniDB episode), 1017-1063 S23E1-47, and one January episode in most other seasons (164 S5E1 ... 1339-1342 S30E1-4). S4E1 repeats S3E5 (same title and date) and stays unmapped; AniDB 955 shares one segment title with S23E25 (2010-06-25, AniDB 1061) as a rerun and is not that episode. The other 1213 regular episodes from 14 on have no TVDB episode and are unmapped so they stop defaulting onto S1 placeholders. TMDB 56389 also uses one season per year: season 1 (1988) holds 1-13, season 2 (1989) 1-50 match 14-63 date for date, and the later seasons number their few episodes absolutely (season 3 E64 1990-01-08 is AniDB 64); each is placed on its season by exact air date, 1287 and 1331 on their year season rather than the 2019/2020 duplicates, and the rest are unmapped. Specials 14-18 are the 2004-2008 Christmas specials at S0E52-56 by title ('04クリスマススペシャル『アンパンマンとクリスマスの星』 ...); the other specials have no TVDB episode, and TMDB season 0 holds only the films, so no special maps there.
